name: Hakrez
description: The whispering kin-tree warden of Anafenza's house and its most skilled warrior, who teaches Anafenza about kin and dies in the ambush.

timeline.summary: Hakrez, the kin-tree warden, teaches Anafenza that the kin-tree belongs to blood-kin and bond-kin alike.
timeline.quote: This tree belongs to all of them.

timeline.summary: Anafenza finds the kin-tree shattered and the warden Hakrez dead.
timeline.quote: Anafenza recognized the lifeless body of Hakrez, the kin-tree warden, whose breastplate was caved in.

relations.note: She is the family's kin-tree warden.
relations.quote: Hakrez, the family's most skilled warrior, became the kin-tree warden.

pages_say.description: The whispering kin-tree warden of Anafenza's house and its most skilled warrior, who teaches Anafenza about kin and dies in the ambush.
